answer_2.quote: Quadratic Weighted Kappa (QWK) is adopted to be the evaluation metric.

answer_4.guideline: Quadratic Weighted Kappa (QWK) is calculated to measure the automated predicted scores (Rater A) and the resolved human scores (Rater B), where w i,j = (i-j) 2 /(L -1) 2 is the difference between scores of the raters, O is an L-by-L histogram matrix, O i,j is the number of essays that received a score i by Rater A and a score j by Rater B, and E is the normalized outer product between each rater's histogram vector of scores.
